$comment: Scenario preset. `scenario` is a contract Scenario; `meta` is Experience-owned descriptive content. Hypotheses are authored expectations, never measured outcomes.

meta.summary: Changes ONLY the Harbor Pass unit price from 1,500 to 2,500 cents at opening. Boards, notices, messages and all other settings are held fixed.
meta.authoredHypothesis: Authored hypothesis (unmeasured): fewer groups buy passes at $25.00; pass revenue per buyer rises. The net effect on revenue and satisfaction is unknown until measured.
